verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference (docs.jitsu.com/api), an HTTP API for workspaces/destinations/syncs, an official jitsu-cli that mirrors the UI, and an MCP server enabling AI agents to configure pipelines, inspect events, and edit functions — squarely matching an AI-native, API-driven usage story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the live OpenAPI spec (probe attempts to fetch it returned 404s at the guessed paths) and third-party validation of the MCP/API workflow beyond vendor docs.
